n01.roman: Level 1, Mahabharat se: Guru Drona ne ped ki choti par ek nakli chidiya rakhwaayi.

n02.roman: Sawaal: tumhe kya dikh raha hai? Yudhishthir bole: ped, aap, bhai aur chidiya. Drona: alag hat jaao!

n03.roman: Duryodhan, Bhim, sabka wahi jawaab. Kisi ko teer chalaane ka mauka hi nahi!

n04.roman: Twist: Arjun bole, sirf chidiya dikh rahi hai. Phir: sirf uska sir! Drona: chalaao! Aur nakli chidiya ka sir, seedha zameen par!

n05.roman: Toh mini-game ka rule: sab dhundhla, sirf target saaf. Focus full, tabhi teer chalega!
